item.title: Here's to Charlie
item.description: Dad passed away unexpectedly yesterday, March 4. He was a thoughtful, funny, healthy, and active 97 years young. We loved him so much. The last thing he said on the phone that evening to Jeff was that he was so incredibly lucky to have us kids. He always said that he was damn lucky.

item.title: The Farm and House in 1949
item.description: Courtney, who (with her husband) rents our house, shared some photos with me from her mom’s photo album from 1949! Small world: Courtney is the great granddaughter of Alfred Kohtz, who Dad bought the house and farm from in the early 1960’s. That’s why Courtney so wanted to live here, and contacted us when she learned from her uncle Lowell that we planned to rent out the house.**

item.title: Loving Lois
item.description: Mom passed away on Sunday after a battle with cancer. For the last 40 years of her life, she managed the farm featured in this blog (which she and Dad bought together in 1963), in addition to being  a writer and nurse. Below are Mom’s obituary, memories from others, and family photos.
